summary: Fixed the 3 major test findings from code-review #3. Added a getCompanyOrDefaults existing-row test to company.test.ts. Added actions.test.ts: no session → redirect to /login with nothing written; session uid 7 → audit user_id 7 and both paths revalidated; invalid input → no revalidation. The dashboard test now renders DashboardPage on the seeded test DB, including the fiscal year just saved through submitCompany and the force-dynamic export. Dropped the copied criterion-14 test. Moved the shared seededDb helper to modern/src/lib/test-db.ts. Locally biome, tsc and vitest all pass (40 tests). 4 commits on ticket/societe-01, pushed: chore(test) vitest JSX, feat(company), feat(societe), feat(dashboard). Ticket PR: https://github.com/guillaumetavernier-theodo/dojo-ai-coding/pull/5 (into feat/societe). Feature PR: https://github.com/guillaumetavernier-theodo/dojo-ai-coding/pull/6 (into main). Left unfixed from the review, and listed in both descriptions: 1 minor (getCompany casts the row without checking the currency) and 3 nits. Environment changes: set the gh default repo to the origin fork, because gh was targeting upstream theodo-group. Added /.factory/node_modules to .git/info/exclude: it is a symlink, so the directory-only .gitignore rule misses it. Blocked: bernard stops on CI_NO_CHECKS because the repo has no CI workflow.
